name: JSON Escape / Unescape
summary: Escape or unescape text for JSON string literals — quotes, newlines, and Unicode.
description: Convert plain text into a JSON-safe escaped string (with optional wrapping quotes) or decode escaped JSON fragments back to readable text. Handles \n, \", \\uXXXX, and more — all in your browser.

faqs.question: Does this produce valid JSON?
faqs.answer: Escape mode outputs a JSON string literal you can paste into JSON. Unescape mode accepts quoted or raw escaped text.

faqs.question: Unicode support?
faqs.answer: Yes — non-ASCII characters can be emitted as \uXXXX or \u{...} sequences.
